title: The Hermit of the Gate
text: An old man sits beside the path with a lantern, as though he has been waiting for this party in particular. He will answer one question.

options.label: Ask about what waits at the end.

outcomes.text: He tells you how the master of this place fights, and you believe him.
He tells you something. It is not true.
He nods as if that was the right answer, too, and touches the Leader's brow as they pass. Their head is clearer than it has been in days.

options.label: The Soothsayer asks him what the cards would not say.

outcomes.text: He answers in the Soothsayer's own voice. It was the right question after all, and the answer is a number: how high their House stands.
He answers, and the answer is about the Soothsayer's own death. They will not say what he told them.
